title: Sindh Development Authorities Second Amendment Ordinance 1997

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Development Authorities Second Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1997
SINDH DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITIES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1997
An Ordinance to amend certain laws relating to
development authorities in force in certain areas of the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 29th October, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(14)/97, dated
29-3-1997.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Development
Authorities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force on
add from 18th June, 1997.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Development Authorities Second Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of Sindh Act V of 1994 and Sindh Act VII of 1995

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1997
SINDH DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITIES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1997
An Ordinance to amend certain laws relating to
development authorities in force in certain areas of the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 29th October, 1997]
No.S.Legis.1(14)/97, dated
29-3-1997.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Sindh Act V of 1994 and Sindh Act VII of 1995.-----In the Sehwan Development
Authority Act, 1993 and the Badin Development Authority Act, 1995, in section
4, in subsection (1), for clauses (a) and (b), the following shall be
substituted and the remaining clauses be renumbered accordingly:-
"(a)
Commissioner of the
Hyderabad Division
.. Chairman. "
